top_signals.title: Emerging-Market ‘Fear Gauge’ Drops as Korea’s Tech Fever Breaks
top_signals.summary: Volatility in emerging-market stocks is dropping at the fastest pace in more than six years as growing investor caution and tighter government curbs cool demand for the biggest Korean tech companies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Seventy Vessels Wait to Load Grain Near Sulina Canal
